item.title: Merseyside museum to hold Transport Fair in March
item.description: The North West Museum of Road Transport at St.Helens, in Merseyside, is holding a Transport Fair and Class Bus Running Day on Sunday, 8th March.

item.title: Half term disruption for Portsmouth Direct Line passengers
item.description: Network Rail is advising passengers who use the Portsmouth Direct Line to plan their journeys ahead of the February half-term break as it carries out various works to maintain and improve the railway.

item.title: Campaign slams lack of funding for reopening railway line
item.description: The Campaign for Reopening the Ivanhoe Line (CRIL) has slammed the absence of funding to reopen the line in the government's transport plans.

item.title: Siemens’ dual-mode locomotive authorised to travel between Germany and Austria
item.description: Rolling stock manufacturer Siemens Mobility has revealed that its Vectron Dual Mode locomotive has been authorised to operate across the border between Germany and Austria.

item.title: Alstom to supply 26 double-decker trains to German regional operator
item.description: Alstom has secured a contract from Germany to supply 26 Coradia Max double-decker trains, including 30-years maintenance and servicing.

item.title: First Caledonian Sleeper runs from Birmingham to the Scottish Highlands
item.description: Caledonian Sleeper's first journey from the English West Midlands to the Scottish Highlands took place overnight on Thursday 15 January.

item.title: Railway photo competition winners – Week 3 2026
item.description: You can see all the recent pictures at www.railadvent.co.uk/locostop and share your pictures for the competition next week. Remember to use the hashtag #feature in the description…

item.title: USA’s Pacific Surfliner route adds daily round trip between Los Angeles and San Diego
item.description: The USA's publicly-owned rail operator, Amtrak, has announced the addition of a new daily service between the cities of Los Angeles and San Diego in California, bringing the number of daily round-trip services to thirteen.

item.title: Major disruption to Hertfordshire trains to last all day
item.description: Passengers are being advised to check before travelling, with a number of operators experiencing major disruption on the East Coast Main Line today. Engineering work…

item.title: 25 Class 66 locomotives sold to Romania in multi-million-pound deal
item.description: 25 Class 66 locomotives are set for a new lease of life, after being sold by DB Cargo UK to Grup Feroviar Roman in Romania.
